content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree in relevant subjects, including the integrated PG degrees in Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology subject from a recognized University or PhD, will be given preference. Experience required: Desirable: Two years R&D / Teaching experience in a relevant subject (Microbiology/Medical Microbiology) after obtaining the essential qualification. Pay: ₹56,000 + 20% HRA per month. Qualification required: Project Technical Support-III: Three-year graduate degree in Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology with 02 years post qualification experience or PG in Microbiology/Medical Microbiology from recognized university; Laboratory Technician: 10th + Diploma in MLT/DMLT/IT or equivalent + 2 years' experience in the relevant subject/field; OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one-year experience in relevant subject. Experience required: As part of the essential qualification above. Pay: ₹28,000 + 20% HRA per month. Qualification required: Research Assistant: PG degree in Microbiology/ Virology/ Biotechnology/ Medical Microbiology/Genetics/ Molecular biology; Staff Nurse: Four-Year Nursing Course from a recognized institution/university. Qualification required: Graduate with knowledge of data entry work. Experience required: Desirable: two years' experience in relevant subject after obtaining essential qualification. Pay: ₹20,000 per month (Consolidated). Qualification required: High School/Matric/equivalent from a recognized board. Experience required: Desirable: Two years' experience in relevant subject after obtaining essential qualification. Pay: ₹18,000 per month (Consolidated).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary/contractual project positions for the IRDL project Initially 11 months or the duration of the project, whichever is earlier; may be extended Renewal based on performance evaluation by the Project Investigator with the approval of the Director Services terminated with 30 days' notice if output norms are not met; one month's notice ordinarily to resign No claim for regular/permanent appointment in AIIMS Nagpur or any other Government organization Tenure ends automatically on completion/closure of the project or expiry of the sanctioned tenure

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), 4 Project Technical Support-III / Laboratory Technician, 3 Research Assistant/Staff Nurse, 1 Data Entry Operator, 1 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Detailed notification) and send it to Professor & Head, Department of Microbiology, Ground Floor, Ayush Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Plot No. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur - 441124, by hard copy to the postal address and soft copy by email (both mandatory), to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹56,000 + 20% HRA per month for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), ₹28,000 + 20% HRA per month for Project Technical Support-III / Laboratory Technician, ₹35,000 per month (Consolidated) for Research Assistant/Staff Nurse, ₹20,000 per month (Consolidated) for Data Entry Operator, ₹18,000 per month (Consolidated) for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-wise: PG degree (PRS-I, Research Assistant); graduate degree with experience, PG, or 10th + DMLT with experience (PTS-III / Lab Technician); Four-Year Nursing Course (Staff Nurse); Graduate (DEO); High School/Matric (MTS). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University/Institution. Experience is counted only after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation must produce valid certificates issued by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications submitted only in the form of a resume/CV will not be considered. Incomplete applications or applications received after the deadline may not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications for eligibility. Shortlisting. Written test/interview. Applications scrutinized for eligibility on educational qualification, experience and other criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary/contractual project positions for the IRDL project. Initially 11 months or the duration of the project, whichever is earlier; may be extended. Renewal based on performance evaluation by the Project Investigator with the approval of the Director.
